images.prompt: Create a premium stylized 3D YouTube thumbnail for KidMotion. Exactly one athletic girl around age 10, warm medium skin, dark curly high ponytail, expressive brown eyes, friendly confident smile. Teal athletic top with coral accents, navy bottoms, teal-and-white sneakers. Place her large on the right in a dynamic but static explorer-power pose. On the left add large clean mobile-readable text exactly: 5 MIN ANIMAL ADVENTURE and smaller FOR KIDS. Strong contrast, premium 3D, 16:9.
